rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: MCP SSH Agent provides AI assistants with secure remote server management capabilities through SSH connections. Developed by AiondaDotCom, this implementation parses SSH configuration files and known_hosts to automatically discover available hosts, then executes commands, transfers files, and manages connectivity using native SSH and SCP commands rather than JavaScript SSH libraries for improved reliability and authentication compatibility. The server offers seven core tools including remote command execution, batch operations, file transfers, connectivity testing, and host information retrieval, making it valuable for system administration, deployment automation, and infrastructure management workflows where AI assistants need to interact with remote servers.
